name: OFILM Group Co., Ltd.
summary: OFILM Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, research, development, production, and sale of optoelectronic products and technologies in Mainland China and internationally. It provides body electronics solutions; smartphone camera modules and lenses; and microelectronics comprising full-screen fingerprint solutions, optical sensing solutions, and WLO wafer level optics.
